messages:
sara: Opening a tiny PR to refresh the 'docklight' quickstart — clarify auth (use .env not inline), swap in a multi-stage Dockerfile, add a GH Actions secret one-liner, and a short note about not committing creds. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5102
omar: Nice. Can you paste the Dockerfile here so I can eyeball it?
sara: Pasted in PR; it's the usual builder/runtime multi-stage + COPY --chown=1000:1000 and ENV PYTHONPATH. No app logic changes.
lee: Two asks: 1) add `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` local example and a minimal .env snippet; 2) add the GH Actions secret command `echo \"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\" | gh secret set REDWOOD_API_KEY` with a 3-line workflow example.
sara: Added both, replaced any examples that printed tokens with placeholders, and added a short troubleshooting tip for macOS Docker networking.
ci-bot: Link-check + secret-scan: link fixed, no secrets detected.
docsbot: Quick editorial suggestion: add a one-line rate-limit pointer: "For sustained >10 req/s consider Dedicated or batching" and link to /docs/dedicated/overview.
sara: Done. I'll merge after CI green and cherry-pick to v-next. Ping me here for follow-ups. :rocket:
